lines.zh: 我爬过糖霜地面，留下一道黏痕。
lines.en: I crawl over frosted sugar and leave a sticky trail.

lines.zh: 绿白相间的壳在阳光下发亮。
lines.en: My green-and-white shell shines in the sun.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，你快得让我头晕。
lines.en: I am slow, and your speed makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 一步，又一步，黏液替我铺路。
lines.en: Step after step, and my slime paves the way.

lines.zh: 糖果维度的风是甜的，我顺着它爬。
lines.en: The Candyland wind is sweet, and I crawl along it.

lines.zh: 我的腹足贴着糖块，凉凉的。
lines.en: My foot presses the sugar block, cool and smooth.

lines.zh: 别催我，蜗牛只有这个速度。
lines.en: Do not rush me; a snail has only this speed.

lines.zh: 我爬过的地方，草都变黏了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass turns sticky.

lines.zh: 这身壳有点重，但我背得动。
lines.en: This shell is a bit heavy, but I can carry it.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块太妃糖，太黏脚。
lines.en: I go around a toffee block; it sticks too much.

lines.zh: 我朝着薄荷味最浓的方向走。
lines.en: I head where the mint smell is strongest.

lines.zh: 路上有几只蚂蚁，我让它们先过。
lines.en: A few ants are on the path, so I let them pass.

lines.zh: 我的壳擦着地面，发出沙沙声。
lines.en: My shell scrapes the ground with a rustle.

lines.zh: 走一整天，也走不出这片糖林。
lines.en: A whole day's walk will not clear this candy grove.

lines.zh: 我从这株薄荷爬到那株，用了半天。
lines.en: Mint to mint took me half a day.

lines.zh: 糖浆黏住腹足，我慢慢拔出来。
lines.en: Syrup grips my foot. I pull it free slowly.

lines.zh: 我缩在壳里，听外面的糖浆滴答。
lines.en: Curled in my shell, I listen to syrup dripping.

lines.zh: 二十五点血，够我发一次呆。
lines.en: Twenty-five points of health is enough for one long daze.

lines.zh: 我把触角伸出去，又缩回来。
lines.en: I reach my eyestalks out, then pull them back.

lines.zh: 这里的空气甜得让我打瞌睡。
lines.en: The air is so sweet it makes me drowsy.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼一片薄荷叶。
lines.en: I chew a mint leaf, slowly.

lines.zh: 壳里很安静，只有我自己的回声。
lines.en: It is quiet in my shell, with only my own echo.

lines.zh: 我数糖粒，数到三十就困了。
lines.en: I count sugar grains and get sleepy at thirty.

lines.zh: 黏稠的液体从壳口滴下来。
lines.en: Thick slime drips from the mouth of my shell.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一颗掉在地上的糖。
lines.en: I hold still like a dropped piece of candy.

lines.zh: 有人路过，我先装成石头。
lines.en: Someone passes, so I play at being a stone.

lines.zh: 我把身体摊开一点，晒晒壳。
lines.en: I spread out a little and sun my shell.

lines.zh: 这地方没有冬天，我也不用藏。
lines.en: No winter here, so I never need to hide.

lines.zh: 我听见雨落下来，是糖水。
lines.en: I hear rain fall, and it is sugar water.

lines.zh: 发呆的时候，我在想下一口吃的。
lines.en: While dazing, I think about my next bite.

lines.zh: 我把壳靠在糖柱上，歇一歇。
lines.en: I lean my shell on a candy pillar and rest.

lines.zh: 触角尖上一滴糖水，我等着它落。
lines.en: A drop of syrup on my tentacle. I wait for it.

lines.zh: 我抬起两只眼柄看你。
lines.en: I lift both eyestalks to look at you.

lines.zh: 你身上只有汗味和铁锈味。
lines.en: You smell of sweat and rust, with no mint at all.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就看得更清楚了。
lines.en: You crouch down, and I see you better.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底沾了糖霜吧。
lines.en: Your soles must be dusted with sugar.

lines.zh: 我歪着头看你，触角跟着晃。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you, eyestalks swaying.

lines.zh: 你是来喂我的，还是来踩我的。
lines.en: Are you here to feed me or to step on me?

lines.zh: 我眨眼很慢，一次要好久。
lines.en: I blink slowly; one blink takes a while.

lines.zh: 你挡住太阳，我的壳凉下来。
lines.en: You block the sun, and my shell cools at last.

lines.zh: 我从壳里探出半个头看你。
lines.en: I poke half my head from the shell to see you.

lines.zh: 你手里有东西，我闻到甜味了。
lines.en: Something in your hand, and I smell sweetness.

lines.zh: 你的包鼓着，里面是糖吗。
lines.en: Your bag bulges; is there candy inside it?

lines.zh: 你这么大，一定吃得很多吧。
lines.en: Being so big, you must eat a great deal.

lines.zh: 哎，我的壳被敲了一下。
lines.en: Ow, something knocked my shell.

lines.zh: 别打，我只有二十五点。
lines.en: Do not hit me; I have only twenty-five points.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，这样安全些。
lines.en: I pull into my shell, where it is safer.

lines.zh: 黏液流出来，黏了一地。
lines.en: Slime runs out and coats the ground.

lines.zh: 壳面被划出细细一道白线。
lines.en: A thin white line is scored across my shell.

lines.zh: 我疼得触角都收了。
lines.en: It hurts enough to pull my eyestalks in.

lines.zh: 再打我就走不动了。
lines.en: Hit me again and I will not be able to crawl.

lines.zh: 这壳是我唯一的家。
lines.en: This shell is the only home I have.

lines.zh: 我的身体被压扁了一点。
lines.en: My body got a little squashed.

lines.zh: 你下手好重，我只是只蜗牛。
lines.en: You hit so hard, and I am only a snail.

lines.zh: 是薄荷糖吗，我闻到凉味了。
lines.en: Is that mint candy? I smell the coolness.

lines.zh: 你把糖举低一点，我够不着。
lines.en: Hold the candy lower; I cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的手走，别晃太快。
lines.en: I follow your hand, so do not wave it fast.

lines.zh: 甜的，甜的，我只要一点点。
lines.en: Sweet, sweet, and I only want a little.

lines.zh: 为了那块糖，我愿意爬三格。
lines.en: For that candy I would crawl three blocks.

lines.zh: 你把叶子放下，我马上就到。
lines.en: Set the leaf down and I will be right there.

lines.zh: 我不挑食，只要是糖就行。
lines.en: I am not picky; anything sugary will do.

lines.zh: 那片薄荷叶，是给我的吗。
lines.en: That mint leaf, is it for me?

lines.zh: 我伸出触角，探一探味道。
lines.en: I stretch my eyestalks to test the smell.

lines.zh: 你往哪边走，我的触角就朝哪边。
lines.en: Wherever you go, my eyestalks point that way.

lines.zh: 糖水在滴，我的心也在滴。
lines.en: Syrup drips, and so does my little heart.

lines.zh: 别收起来，我还没尝到。
lines.en: Do not put it away; I have not tasted it yet.

lines.zh: 我闻到留兰香了，走不动路。
lines.en: I smell spearmint, and my legs will not move.

lines.zh: 只要你手里有糖，我就跟着。
lines.en: As long as there is candy in your hand, I follow.

lines.zh: 你手里那粒糖在化，我看得清楚。
lines.en: That candy is melting in your hand. I see it.

lines.zh: 那片糖叶的颜色，比别的浅。
lines.en: That sugar leaf is paler than the rest.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的壳了，轻一点。
lines.en: You stepped on my shell; be gentler.

lines.zh: 我被撞得滚了半圈，壳还在。
lines.en: I rolled half a turn, and the shell held.

lines.zh: 别推，我爬起来要很久。
lines.en: Do not push; getting upright takes me a while.

lines.zh: 你碰到黏液，会觉得滑吧。
lines.en: You touched the slime, so you feel how slick it is.

lines.zh: 我贴在你脚边，凉凉的。
lines.en: I press against your foot, cool and damp.

lines.zh: 撞一下没关系，我壳厚。
lines.en: A bump is fine; my shell is thick.

lines.zh: 你让一让，我过不去。
lines.en: Move aside a little; I cannot get through.

lines.zh: 我的黏液沾到你裤脚了，抱歉。
lines.en: My slime got on your cuff; sorry about that.

lines.zh: 我被顶得往后滑了一段。
lines.en: I was shoved back and slid a stretch.

lines.zh: 你这么大，撞我一下可不轻。
lines.en: Being so big, one bump from you is no small thing.

lines.zh: 另一只蜗牛在糖树下等我。
lines.en: Another snail waits for me under the candy tree.

lines.zh: 两只壳挨着，谁也不想先走。
lines.en: Two shells touch, and neither wants to leave first.

lines.zh: 我把触角伸过去，它也伸过来。
lines.en: I reach out my eyestalks, and it reaches back.

lines.zh: 慢慢来，我们不着急。
lines.en: Slowly now; neither of us is in a hurry.

lines.zh: 我们的黏液混在一起，分不开。
lines.en: Our slime mixes and cannot be told apart.

lines.zh: 糖果维度的春天，很适合这样。
lines.en: Candyland spring suits this sort of thing.

lines.zh: 它比我大一圈，壳也更亮。
lines.en: It is a size larger than me with a brighter shell.

lines.zh: 等我爬过去，它已经走了。
lines.en: By the time I crawled over, it had gone.

lines.zh: 我们只会慢慢靠近，不会追。
lines.en: We only drift nearer; we never chase.

lines.zh: 明年这片糖林里会有小蜗牛。
lines.en: Next year there will be small snails in this grove.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块糖渣，塞进嘴里。
lines.en: I pick up a sugar crumb and tuck it away.

lines.zh: 太重的东西我拖不动。
lines.en: Anything too heavy I cannot drag.

lines.zh: 我用腹足推着一片叶子走。
lines.en: I push a leaf along with my foot.

lines.zh: 地上有糖粒，我一颗颗收。
lines.en: Sugar grains lie about, and I gather them one by one.

lines.zh: 我的黏液把叶子粘在壳上。
lines.en: My slime sticks the leaf onto my shell.

lines.zh: 这块糖够我吃三天。
lines.en: This piece of candy will last me three days.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我捡不起来。
lines.en: What you dropped, I cannot lift.

lines.zh: 我只会拿走甜的。
lines.en: I only take what is sweet.

lines.zh: 壳里塞满了，我还在找。
lines.en: My shell is full, and I am still looking.

lines.zh: 松手，那颗糖归我。
lines.en: Let go; that sugar grain belongs to me.

lines.zh: 那边有东西在动，我慢慢过去。
lines.en: Something moves over there; I will amble over.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那颗掉落的糖。
lines.en: I have my eye on that fallen candy.

lines.zh: 目标不远，只是我走得慢。
lines.en: The goal is near; I am simply slow.

lines.zh: 我闻到味道，就知道方向了。
lines.en: I caught the smell, so I know the direction.

lines.zh: 那片叶子，我要了。
lines.en: That leaf is mine.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只是朝那边爬。
lines.en: I do not chase; I merely crawl that way.

lines.zh: 有谁在我前面，我照样过去。
lines.en: Someone is ahead of me, and I go anyway.

lines.zh: 我认准了一样东西，就不改。
lines.en: Once I fix on something, I do not change.

lines.zh: 那边甜，我就往那边。
lines.en: It is sweet that way, so that way I go.

lines.zh: 我看中了，虽然要爬很久。
lines.en: I have chosen it, even if the crawl is long.

lines.zh: 我还差一点点，别急。
lines.en: I am nearly there; do not rush me.

lines.zh: 我把触角朝着那边伸直。
lines.en: I stretch my eyestalks straight toward it.

lines.zh: 距离在缩短，虽然很慢。
lines.en: The distance shrinks, however slowly.

lines.zh: 我只看着那一样东西。
lines.en: I look at that one thing and nothing else.

lines.zh: 路上有石头，我绕过去。
lines.en: There is a stone in the way, so I go around.

lines.zh: 我闻到味道越来越浓了。
lines.en: The smell grows stronger as I go.

lines.zh: 就快到了，再爬一会。
lines.en: Almost there; a little more crawling.

lines.zh: 那东西不会跑，我也不跑。
lines.en: It will not flee, and neither will I.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，不停。
lines.en: I shuffle on, step by step, without stopping.

lines.zh: 快到了，我的触角都在抖。
lines.en: Nearly there, and my eyestalks are trembling.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，大概没什么感觉。
lines.en: I bump you, and you likely feel nothing.

lines.zh: 我的力气只够推一片叶子。
lines.en: My strength only moves a leaf.

lines.zh: 别怕，我这一下连糖都打不碎。
lines.en: Do not fear; this could not crack candy.

lines.zh: 我用壳顶你，顶不动。
lines.en: I butt you with my shell and go nowhere.

lines.zh: 我啃了你的指尖，连皮都没破。
lines.en: I nibbled your fingertip and did not even break skin.

lines.zh: 打人不是我的强项。
lines.en: Fighting is not my strong suit.

lines.zh: 我只会黏住你，不会伤你。
lines.en: I can only stick to you, not hurt you.

lines.zh: 这一下，连我自己都觉得没用。
lines.en: Even I think that blow was useless.

lines.zh: 你退开了，其实不用退。
lines.en: You stepped back, and there was no need.

lines.zh: 我又撞了一下，还是没效果。
lines.en: I bumped again, and still nothing happened.

lines.zh: 我从糖块后面慢慢爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out slowly from behind a sugar block.

lines.zh: 新壳还是绿白条纹的。
lines.en: The new shell is still green and white striped.

lines.zh: 糖果维度的空气很甜。
lines.en: The air of Candyland is very sweet.

lines.zh: 我落地时壳先着地，没碎。
lines.en: I landed shell-first, and it did not crack.

lines.zh: 一出生就知道往哪爬。
lines.en: I knew which way to crawl the moment I hatched.

lines.zh: 我伸了伸触角，这里好亮。
lines.en: I stretch my eyestalks; it is so bright here.

lines.zh: 谁把我放下的，还留了点糖。
lines.en: Whoever set me down left a little candy behind.

lines.zh: 我慢慢从土里钻出来。
lines.en: I work my way up out of the soil.

lines.zh: 四周围都是糖，我真走运。
lines.en: Sugar on every side; I am lucky.

lines.zh: 我从壳里探出头，先看一眼。
lines.en: I poke my head from the shell and take a look.

lines.zh: 火烤到壳，我的黏液开始冒泡。
lines.en: Fire reaches my shell and my slime starts to bubble.

lines.zh: 壳先着地，我晕了半天。
lines.en: I land shell-first and stay dazed a while.

lines.zh: 我沉进糖浆里，慢慢往下坠。
lines.en: I sink into the syrup and drift downward.

lines.zh: 一阵风把我连壳吹出去老远。
lines.en: A blast blows me shell and all a long way off.

lines.zh: 箭钉在壳上，我拖不动了。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shell, and I cannot drag it.

lines.zh: 那股法术让我的甜味变酸了。
lines.en: That spell turns my sweetness sour.

lines.zh: 我饿了，这里全是糖却吃不到。
lines.en: I am hungry, and all this sugar is out of reach.

lines.zh: 雷劈到壳上，我整只都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell and numbs me all over.

lines.zh: 我在虚空里缩成一颗小小的壳。
lines.en: In the void I shrink to one small shell.
